purpose: Draws a stakeholder's header with circle chips, kind chips and the vault photo.
namedChanges: The imports are the peers': `cardName` and the type `OnlineCardController` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-online-card`; the type `PersonCard`, `displayPlacements` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-person-connections`; `ContactHeader`, `contactInitials` and the types `ContactHeaderSlotImage`, `ContactHeaderRelation` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-contact-header`; `imageShapeOf` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-stakeholder-ui-kit`; `useOnlineCardState` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-one-card`; `placementChip`, `edgesToVault`, `headerRelations`, `chipText` and the types `CatalogueEntry`, `ChipTone`, `ContactChip`, `LabelAxis` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-contact-kind-model`; `USER_VOCAB_KEY`, `readHeaderVocab`, `VocabUnreadableError`, `readPredicateCurie` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-contact-kind-catalogue`; `vaultLabel` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-vault-list`; `typeLocalName` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-lws-vault-sets`; the type `ReachableVault` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-plan-record-hooks`; `RemoveControl` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-remove-control`; `annotationsFit` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-contact-annotation` (0.1.1); the other imports are the unit's own files (in the source: `gilb-stakeholders`, `gilb-stakeholders-ui`, `../../lib/...`, `../mynet/...`, `./ContactCardSlots`). The re-export `export { USER_VOCAB_KEY, VocabUnreadableError, readHeaderVocab } from` names the peer's module.

Six host members are added (the interface `StakeholderContactHeaderHost` and its context, read by `useStakeholderContactHeaderHost()`, which throws an error naming the missing provider): `discoverVaultProfilePhoto`, `loadPhotoObjectUrl`, `loadGranteeFace`, `useHolderOriginLine`, `useContactLabels`, `useRelations`. Each source call `f(` is `host.f(` at the same place and with the same arguments. `StakeholderContactHeader`, `useHolderFaceCache` (private), `useTheirFace` (private) and `useHeaderRelations` each begin with `const host = useStakeholderContactHeaderHost();` (before it, the source's first statement), a context read that adds no query and no call.

`HeaderRelationsState.labels` is typed `ContactLabelsState` (the members of the app's `ContactLabelsState` that the unit reads, declared in `stakeholderContactHeaderHost.ts`) instead of `ReturnType<typeof useContactLabels>`.

`annotationsFit` (GilbApp `src/lib/contact/contactAnnotation.ts:66`) was a private function of `useHeaderRelations.ts` in 0.1.0 (the same tokens, without `export`); since 0.1.1 it is imported from `contact-annotation` and the private copy is deleted (the two were compared first: 38 words, 0 diff lines)
`GILBAPP_CHIP_HELP` (GilbApp `src/components/records/ContactCardSlots.tsx:33`) is moved into this unit (`src/gilbappChipHelp.ts`), the same line; the rest of that file is not in the unit.

`src/stakeholderContactHeaderHost.ts` declares the structural types the members need: `VaultProfilePhotoState` (`photoRef`, `personName`), `HeldKindVault`, `ContactLabelsArgs`, `ContactLabelsState`, `HolderOriginLineArgs` (`linkAnswer` is `ResolveOutcome["kind"]` of `person-connections`).

Comments made generic (cycle, ticket, spec and design-note tags, person and agent names, and app names removed from the files' comments); no code change. The header comment of `StakeholderContactHeader.tsx` says layout `auto`, as the code does.
Nothing else changed: the four query keys and their options, the texts and the markup are the source's. No origin is held at load, so no setting unit is used.
